campaign_name: TA444 Salary Adjustments campaign targeting US digital banking
targeting_evidence: The threat actor deliberately targeted a medium-sized digital banking institution in the Unites States using a tailored lure.
target: Medium-sized digital banking insitution in the United States

roles.role_victim: Employees at a medium-sized digital banking institution

request: Click a malicious URL masquerading as a shared PDF document ('Salary Adjustments 202202101019.pdf) to trigger an infection chain delivering the CageyChameleon malware.
pretext: The victim receives a notification that a document regarding 'Salary Adjustments' has been shared with them.

note_on_ambiguity: The source document is a actor profile excluded under Rule #3. This specific campaign is presented as an illustrative case within the report because it contains sufficient details and targeting evidence to be coded under Decision Rule #8. Display-name spoofing was coded because the screenshot shows the sender pretending to be Kevin McDonnell but using a freemail address (kmcdonnell61@gmail.com) rather than a spoofed corporate domain. Persuasion principles were marked as 'Not specified in the report' to reflect that the report does not provide sufficient information to determine which persuasion principles were used in this campaign.
